correctness.rationale: For unit vertex directions u_i of a centered regular n-simplex, sum_i u_i=0 and sum_i u_i u_i^T=((n+1)/n)I. Since d_i(P)=r+<u_i,p>, summing squared differences gives ((n+1)/n)||P-Q||^2 exactly. The barycentric identity d_i=(n+1)r lambda_i identifies the image and inverse map; setting Q at the center gives the second-moment formulas. Independent random checks in dimensions 2 through 7 reproduced the identities.
